title: Add auth token handling and companion API functions to React client
description:
Modify react_ui/src/api/client.ts to add authentication API functions (signup, login, logout, fetchMe) with automatic Bearer token attachment, token storage management, and companion CRUD API functions.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (existing API client — understand the fetch wrapper pattern, base URL configuration, TypeScript conventions, and existing function signatures)
- chatbot/api/auth.py (created by task c.7 — endpoint paths, request bodies, response shapes)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY react_ui/src/api/client.ts. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open react_ui/src/api/client.ts and inspect:
   - The fetch wrapper or base fetch function used by all existing API calls.
   - How the base URL is configured (empty string, env var, or constant).
   - TypeScript naming conventions for interfaces vs types.
   - Error handling patterns (ApiError class, try/catch, etc.).
   - Existing function export patterns.

2. Add TypeScript interfaces/types:
   - `User`: user_id (string), username (string), email (string).
   - `AuthTokens`: access_token (string), token_type (string), user (User).
   - `Companion`: companion_id (string), user_id (string), name (string), persona (string | null), description (string | null), avatar_url (string | null).
   - `CompanionCreate`: name (string), persona (string | null), description (string | null), avatar_url (string | null).

3. Add token management:
   - An internal module-scoped variable `let accessToken: string | null = null`.
   - `setAccessToken(token: string): void` — stores token in the module variable and in localStorage under key 'auth_token'.
   - `getAccessToken(): string | null` — returns the module variable, initializing from localStorage on first call.
   - `clearAccessToken(): void` — clears the module variable and removes 'auth_token' from localStorage.
   - On module load, initialize `accessToken` from localStorage.getItem('auth_token').

4. Extend the fetch wrapper to automatically attach the Bearer token:
   - If accessToken is set, add `Authorization: Bearer ${accessToken}` header to all requests.
   - This should work without changing existing function signatures — modify the underlying fetch wrapper function (e.g., `fetchApi`) to include the header conditionally.

5. Add auth API functions:
   - `async signup(username: string, email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthTokens>`:
     * POST /auth/signup with JSON body { username, email, password }.
     * On success, call setAccessToken(response.access_token) and return the AuthTokens.
   - `async login(email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthTokens>`:
     * POST /auth/login with JSON body { email, password }.
     * On success, call setAccessToken(response.access_token) and return the AuthTokens.
   - `async logout(): Promise<void>`:
     * POST /auth/logout.
     * Call clearAccessToken().
   - `async fetchMe(): Promise<User>`:
     * GET /auth/me.
     * Returns User.

6. Add companion API functions:
   - `async createCompanion(data: CompanionCreate): Promise<Companion>`: POST /companions.
   - `async listCompanions(): Promise<Companion[]>`: GET /companions.
   - `async getCompanion(companionId: string): Promise<Companion>`: GET /companions/{companionId}.
   - `async updateCompanion(companionId: string, data: Partial<CompanionCreate>): Promise<Companion>`: PATCH /companions/{companionId}.
   - `async deleteCompanion(companionId: string): Promise<void>`: DELETE /companions/{companionId}.

7. DO NOT remove, rename, or change the signature of any existing exported function in client.ts.

react_ui/src/api/client.ts exports User, AuthTokens, Companion, CompanionCreate types
react_ui/src/api/client.ts exports createCompanion, listCompanions, getCompanion, updateCompanion, deleteCompanion
Access token is automatically attached to all authenticated API calls via fetchApi
Existing API functions in client.ts are unchanged in name and signature
